question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Apex
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2) i.e. "**Bottom**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Apex**: (चोटी) - The top or highest part of something.

 
 
• **Example**: The mountain's apex was covered in snow.
 
 
 
• **Bottom**: (नीचे का भाग) - The lowest point or part.
 
 
• **Example**: He started from the bottom of the corporate ladder.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Bottom**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pinnacle**: (चरम बिंदु) - The most successful point; the culmination.
 
• **Farthest**: (सबसे दूर) - At the greatest distance.
 
• **Watchful**: (सावधान) - Watching or observing attentively.
